Mona (AE): Quick heads-up  launching the NovaHealth POC intake. Customer wants a 3-week technical POC to validate search relevance + cost savings. Can we run a kickoff Wed 10am CET?
Dev (SE): Wed 10 works. What are their top-level goals?
Mona (AE): They listed: 1) Replace current vendor for semantic search with <= 30% query latency increase; 2) Achieve Precision@5 >= 0.7 on their annotation set; 3) Reduce inference spend by ~50% vs today.
Priya (Eng): Noted. For infra I'd propose hosted Redwood API first, then Dedicated for final runs if we need stable p95. We'll need dataset ingest (5k labeled queries) and a HEADLESS eval harness.
Hana (CS): I'll own client invites and the demo app. Who should be on the kickoff from their side?
Mona (AE): PO (Lena), Data Lead (Ibrahim), Sec Reviewer (contracted). They want EU residency and SSO.
Leo (Security): EU residency triggers DPA + proof of logging/audit retention. Also: KMS integration question and whether logs can be forwarded to their SIEM. I'll send templated answers.
Dev (SE): Questions for scope: a) exact eval metric (Precision@5 vs NDCG), b) expected QPS baseline and peak, c) whether they allow test traffic to hit production search.
Mona (AE): I'll ask them to confirm metrics, daily peak QPS (they said ~40), and data sensitivity (no PHI).
Priya (Eng): For success criteria let's capture executable checks: - p95 tail latency <= 400ms at 30qps - Precision@5 >= 0.7 on their test set - End-to-end cost per 10k queries <= $Y (estimate soon).
Hana (CS): Proposed kickoff agenda (30m): 1) intros (5m) 2) scope & success criteria (10m) 3) data & security checklist (5m) 4) timelines & owners (5m) 5) Qs/blockers (5m).
Mona (AE): Perfect. Timeline: Week0 (kickoff + SSQ + dataset share), Week1 (baseline + tuning), Week2 (more tuning + Dedicated runs), Week3 (final eval & handoff). If they need on-prem, add 6 weeks.
Dev (SE): Operational items: create trial project, generate API key scoped to project, pin model to rwd-embed-v2 / rwd-chat-v1. Enable prefix caching. I'll add a runbook in the shared doc with commands like: ```
# create trial project
redwood projects create --name nova-poc --region eu
# api key
redwood apikeys create --project nova-poc --scopes=generate,embeddings
```
Leo (Security): I'll need their completed SSQ v3 and a data flow diagram by Day2. Also confirm retention windows for logs and request types forwarded.
Mona (AE): Blockers noted: 1) DPA timeline (legal) 2) SSO config lead time (if required) 3) Data delivery format.
Hana (CS): Pricing ask: they want committed vs burst pricing options. I'll prepare a quick delta: Hosted pay-as-you-go, 3-month commit, and 6/12-month Dedicated commit tiers.
Priya (Eng): One more: autoscale policy for 40->80qps bursts. We'll set a soft cap and alerting to avoid cost surprises.
Mona (AE): Action items: Mona  request metric confirmation + data share (due EOD Mon). Dev  infra runbook + eval harness (due Wed AM). Leo  security kickoff + SSQ template (due Tue). Hana  pricing delta + invite (due EOD today).
gcal-bot: Meeting created: "NovaHealth POC Kickoff" Wed 10:00 CET, 30m. Invites sent.
Mona (AE): Thanks all  I'll post the shared drive link and client answers here after the call. :white_check_mark:
